title: 第692章 飞天艾可第690章 笨笨狐
slug: 性转狐狸开局就被抓走了
content_zh:
艾可将一堆金属器物搬到一旁，却不见梅的身影。
“你是在找她？她正在炼丹药。”大宗师戴露看上去精神比往日好些，只是面色阴沉。
“炼好吃的丹丸吗？”艾可打趣一句，可瞧见对方脸色愈发难看，当即闭上了嘴。
在她眼里，戴露大概是此地最不好招惹的人。
“好在我再也不必被迫服食那些丹药了。”戴露神色郑重地点点头。她绝不会再遭遇伏击、受人背叛！
往后万事都要经过她的神通推演，再细微的动静，都逃不过她的双眼。
“还有，注意言辞，我并没有那么吓人！”戴露轻轻叹了口气，怎么所有人都觉得她凶神恶煞……
“你训练弟子的时候，敢再说一遍这话吗？”艾可心想戴露怕是根本不清楚，她的修炼课程几乎等同于死劫试炼。
【那一对双胞胎也真是厉害，承受这般折磨却毫无怨言。】艾可暗自感慨，心中颇为佩服二人。
“第一，休得无礼。第二，他俩成天抱怨不停，只不过一同修行，能够相互扶持罢了。”戴露点点头，对双胞胎的韧性颇为欣赏。
“照这个进度，他们说不定很快就能渡劫飞升了。”艾可随口笑道，可看见戴露神色毫无变化，不由得心里一紧，“你可得拦住他们飞升！咱们还有许多乐子没体验呢！”
她生怕自己被众人甩在身后，看来自己也得抓紧修行进度。
【可要忙活的事情实在太多了啊……】艾可内心哀嚎。一堆繁杂事务压得她头昏脑胀，什么都不想动手。
“说起来，你的九尾很快就能全数恢复了。”艾可望向戴露身后，暗自想象对方九尾重聚之后身姿会何等丰盈。
“你日后也会长出新的狐尾，别胡思乱想这种失礼的事情。”戴露万万没想到，短短片刻不见，艾可竟变得如此肆无忌惮。
“行了，看来你还得加练！”戴露不悦地哼了一声，当即拽着艾可往外走去。
“现在道歉还来得及吗？”艾可压根不想修炼，手头还有一大堆琐事等着处理。
“太迟了。”戴露冷哼一声，不再理会她。
“我这下要遭殃了。”艾可长叹一声。
……

“你在干什么？”戴露看向艾可，只见对方立刻像乌龟一般，把身体蜷缩起来。
“防御。”艾可心知暴怒状态下的戴可十分恐怖，没人能护住自己，她不敢有半点侥幸。
“比起上次，这层防御扎实了不少。”戴露心中微微赞许，随即运足全部力量，试图将屏障击碎。
“呀！”艾可急忙闪身躲开，戴露一剑劈开了【月之甲壳】。
“这层防御虽有破绽，寻常肉身修士已经很难伤到你。”戴露认真点评。
“穿透力不足是最大弱点。但如果你能将这层甲壳进一步凝练，多少能弥补这个缺陷。”戴露从未见过这类法门，一时也想不出更好的改良方式。
“不过天底下还没有我斩不断的东西，你依旧赢不了我。”戴露自得地轻哼，她依旧能够制服这只滑头狐狸！
“天底下没有你斩不断的东西？”艾可咧开嘴笑了起来。
“自然。”戴露十分骄傲。
【嘿嘿嘿嘿~】艾可心底暗笑。
【系统，过来帮我一把。】艾可暗中呼唤。
【旁人不可随意出手相助，公主。】
“我晓得我晓得，就破例这一次。”艾可露出狡黠的笑容。
【……】
艾可仿佛听见系统无奈地叹气，但对方终究还是顺着她的心意出手。
一面熟悉的黑色墙体凭空显现，墙体上还开着一处小小的孔洞。
content_en:
Ai Ke moved a bunch of metal objects aside, but Mei was nowhere to be seen.
"Are you looking for her? She is refining elixirs." Grand Master Dai Lu seemed to be in better spirits than before, but his face was gloomy.
"Can you make delicious pills?" Ai Ke joked, but when he saw that the other person's face was becoming more and more ugly, he immediately closed his mouth.
In her eyes, Dai Lu is probably the most difficult person to mess with here.
"Fortunately, I no longer have to be forced to take those pills." Dai Lu nodded solemnly. She will never be ambushed or betrayed again!
Everything from now on will have to be deduced by her magical powers, and no matter how subtle the movement is, it will not escape her eyes.
"Also, be careful with your words, I'm not that scary!" Dai Lu sighed softly, why did everyone think she was so vicious...
"When you are training your disciples, do you dare to say this again?" Ai Ke thought to herself that Dai Lu was probably not clear at all. Her training course was almost equivalent to a death trial.
[Those twins are really amazing. They endured such torture without complaining. ] Ai Ke sighed secretly, admiring the two of them in his heart.
"First, quit being rude. Second, they complain all day long, but they just practice together and can support each other." Dai Lu nodded, admiring the twins' resilience.
"According to this progress, they might be able to overcome the catastrophe and ascend soon." Ai Ke smiled casually, but when he saw that Dai Lu's expression did not change, he couldn't help but feel nervous, "You have to stop them from ascending! We still have a lot of fun yet to experience!"
She was afraid that she would be left behind by everyone, so it seemed that she had to speed up her practice.
[There are so many things to be busy with...] Aike wailed inwardly. The pile of complicated things made her dizzy, and she didn't want to do anything.
"Speaking of which, your Nine-Tails will be fully recovered soon." Aike looked behind Dai Lu, secretly imagining how plump his figure would be after the Nine-Tails were reunited.
"You will also grow a new fox tail in the future, don't think about such disrespectful things." Dai Lu never expected that Ai Ke would become so unscrupulous after not seeing each other for just a moment.
"Okay, it seems you need to practice more!" Dai Lu snorted displeasedly and immediately dragged Ai Ke out.
"Is it too late to apologize now?" Ai Ke didn't want to practice at all and had a lot of trivial matters waiting to be dealt with.
"It's too late." Dai Lu snorted and ignored her.
"I'm going to be in trouble now." Ai Ke sighed.
…
"What are you doing?" Dai Lu looked at Aike and saw that the other person immediately curled up like a turtle.
"Defense." Ai Ke knew that Dai Ke in a furious state was very scary and no one could protect her. She didn't dare to have any luck.
"Compared to last time, this layer of defense is much stronger." Dai Lu approved slightly in his heart, and then used all his strength to try to break the barrier.
"Yeah!" Ai Ke hurriedly dodged, and Dai Lu split the [Moon Carapace] with a sword.
"Although there are flaws in this layer of defense, it is difficult for ordinary physical monks to hurt you." Dai Lu commented seriously.
"The lack of penetration is the biggest weakness. But if you can further condense this layer of carapace, you can make up for this flaw to some extent." Dai Lu has never seen this kind of method, and can't think of a better way to improve it at the moment.
"But there's nothing in the world that I can't kill, and you still can't defeat me." Dai Lu hummed proudly, she could still subdue this naughty fox!
"Is there anything in the world that you can't kill?" Ai Ke grinned.
"Naturally." Dai Lu was very proud.
[Hehehehe~] Aike smiled secretly in his heart.
[System, come over and help me. ] Ai Ke secretly called.
[Others are not allowed to help at will, princess. 】
"I know, I know, I'll make an exception this time." Ai Ke showed a sly smile.
【……】
Aike seemed to hear the system sighing helplessly, but the other party stillFollow her wishes.
A familiar black wall appeared out of thin air, with a small hole in the wall.
